name: stop-slop
description_en: Remove the AI accent: fewer boilerplate phrases, parallelisms and empty adjectives.
description_zh: 去掉文字的「AI 腔」：减少套话、排比与空洞形容词，让表达更像人写的。

name: gpt-researcher
description_en: Multi-source research on a question, producing a cited report.
description_zh: 对一个问题做多源检索并生成带引用的研究报告。

name: planning-with-files
description_en: Keep plans in files instead of context, so progress survives a cleared conversation.
description_zh: 把计划写进文件而不是上下文，避免对话清空后丢失进度。

name: frontend-slides
description_en: Build slide decks with web tech (HTML/CSS) for talks and demos.
description_zh: 用前端技术生成幻灯片（HTML/CSS），适合分享与演示。

name: criteria-audit
description_en: Audit whether a direction is worth doing with three criteria and three axes.
description_zh: 用三条硬判据 + 三根轴审查一个方向值不值得做。

name: disk-space-audit
description_en: Audit disk usage and reclaim space safely: inventory, verify, then delete.
description_zh: 审计磁盘占用并安全回收空间：先盘点、再验证、最后才删。

name: grammar-check
description_en: Find grammar, logic and flow issues and suggest targeted fixes without rewriting the whole text.
description_zh: 检查文本的语法、逻辑与行文问题，给出针对性修改建议，而不是整段重写。

name: summarize-meeting
description_en: Turn a meeting transcript into structured notes: date, participants, topics, decisions, action items and owners.
description_zh: 把会议记录整理成结构化纪要：日期、参会人、议题、关键决定、待办与负责人。

name: competitor-analysis
description_en: Analyze competitors: strengths, weaknesses, differentiation opportunities — and flag claims without evidence.
description_zh: 拆解竞品：优势、劣势、差异机会，并指出哪些结论证据不足。

name: market-sizing
description_en: Estimate market size with TAM / SAM / SOM, using both top-down and bottom-up approaches.
description_zh: 用 TAM / SAM / SOM 估算市场，同时给自上而下与自下而上两种算法。

name: user-personas
description_en: Build three user personas from research data: JTBD, pains, gains and trigger situations.
description_zh: 从调研数据生成 3 个用户画像：JTBD、痛点、收益与触发场景。

name: customer-journey-map
description_en: Map an end-to-end customer journey: stages, touchpoints, emotions, pain points and opportunities.
description_zh: 画出端到端客户旅程：阶段、触点、情绪、痛点与机会点。

name: slides
description_en: Build strategic HTML presentations with Chart.js: design tokens, responsive layouts, charts and copy structure.
description_zh: 用 HTML + Chart.js 做策略型演示：设计 token、响应式布局、图表与文案结构。

name: ideal-customer-profile
description_en: Derive an Ideal Customer Profile from research: demographics, behaviors, JTBD, buying triggers and exclusions.
description_zh: 从调研数据提炼 ICP：人口特征、行为、JTBD、购买触发与排除条件。

name: cohort-analysis
description_en: Cohort analysis of retention and behavior: retention curves, feature adoption trends and segment differences.
description_zh: 做留存与行为的分群分析：留存曲线、功能采用趋势与分群差异。

name: job-stories
description_en: Write job stories in the When…I want…so I can… format, with verifiable acceptance criteria.
description_zh: 用 When…I want…so I can… 句式写 job story，并附可验证的验收标准。

name: user-stories
description_en: Write user stories following 3C (Card / Conversation / Confirmation) and INVEST.
description_zh: 按 3C（Card / Conversation / Confirmation）与 INVEST 写用户故事。

name: test-scenarios
description_en: Generate test scenarios from user stories: objectives, preconditions, roles, steps and expected outcomes.
description_zh: 从用户故事生成测试场景：目标、前置条件、角色、步骤与预期结果。

name: sentiment-analysis
description_en: Analyze user feedback: segments, sentiment scores, JTBD and satisfaction insights.
description_zh: 分析用户反馈：分群、情感分数、JTBD 与满意度洞察。

name: market-segments
description_en: Identify 3–5 potential customer segments with demographics, JTBD and product fit.
description_zh: 识别 3–5 个潜在客群：人口特征、JTBD 与产品匹配度。

name: user-segmentation
description_en: Segment users by behavior, JTBD and needs into at least 3 groups, with the rationale.
description_zh: 按行为、JTBD 与需求把用户分成至少 3 群，并说明分群依据。

name: lean-canvas
description_en: A one-page Lean Canvas: problem, solution, metrics, cost, channels, revenue and unfair advantage.
description_zh: 一页 Lean Canvas：问题、方案、指标、成本、渠道、收入与不公平优势。

name: business-model
description_en: A nine-block Business Model Canvas: segments, value prop, channels, relationships, revenue, resources, activities, partners, costs.
description_zh: 九宫格 Business Model Canvas：客户细分、价值主张、渠道、关系、收入、资源、活动、伙伴、成本。

name: swot-analysis
description_en: SWOT analysis — strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats — with concrete actions.
description_zh: SWOT 分析：优势、劣势、机会、威胁，并给出可执行的应对动作。

name: pricing-strategy
description_en: Design a pricing strategy: model, competitive comparison, value metric and a path to raise prices.
description_zh: 设计定价策略：定价模型、竞品对比、价值度量与涨价路径。

name: create-prd
description_en: Write a lean, decision-ready PRD: problem, goals, scope, acceptance criteria and non-goals.
description_zh: 写一份精简、可决策的 PRD：问题、目标、范围、验收标准与不做什么。

name: release-notes
description_en: Turn tickets, PRDs or changelogs into user-facing release notes.
description_zh: 把工单/PRD/变更日志写成用户能看懂的发布说明。

name: retro
description_en: Facilitate a structured retrospective: what went well, what to improve, start/stop/continue.
description_zh: 主持一次结构化复盘：做得好、可改进、继续做/停止做/开始做。

name: privacy-policy
description_en: Draft a privacy policy: data collected, purposes, sharing, retention, user rights and compliance statements.
description_zh: 起草隐私政策：收集哪些数据、用途、共享、保留期限、用户权利与合规声明。

name: draft-nda
description_en: Draft a mutual NDA: scope, term, exceptions, breach and jurisdiction.
description_zh: 起草双方的保密协议（NDA）：保密范围、期限、例外、违约与管辖。

name: interview-script
description_en: Design a customer interview script: JTBD probing, non-leading questions, staged flow.
description_zh: 设计用户访谈脚本：JTBD 追问、避免诱导性提问、按阶段推进。

name: summarize-interview
description_en: Turn an interview transcript into a structured summary: context, pains, current solutions, quotes and assumptions to test.
description_zh: 把访谈转写整理成结构化摘要：背景、痛点、现有方案、关键原话与待验证假设。

name: value-prop-statements
description_en: Generate value proposition statements: who, what problem, why believe it, next step.
description_zh: 生成价值主张句式：面向谁、解决什么、凭什么信、下一步做什么。

name: banner-design
description_en: Design social, ad and website banners: sizes, hierarchy, copy and focal point.
description_zh: 设计社媒/广告/网站横幅：尺寸、层级、文案与视觉焦点。

name: brainstorm-okrs
description_en: Brainstorm team-level OKRs aligned with company objectives, separating measurable outcomes from key actions.
description_zh: 围绕公司目标 brainstorm 团队级 OKR，区分可量化结果与关键动作。

name: outcome-roadmap
description_en: Turn a feature roadmap into an outcome roadmap: each phase maps to a measurable business outcome.
description_zh: 把「功能路线图」改写成「结果路线图」：每个阶段对应一个可衡量的业务结果。

name: north-star-metric
description_en: Define a North Star Metric with 3–5 input metrics and the causal chain between them.
description_zh: 定义北极星指标与 3–5 个输入指标，并说明它们之间的因果链。

name: competitive-battlecard
description_en: Sales-ready competitive battlecards: our strengths, their strengths, common objections and responses.
description_zh: 做销售用的竞品 battlecard：我方优势、对方强项、客户常见异议与应对话术。

name: gtm-strategy
description_en: Build a go-to-market strategy: channels, messaging, pricing, launch actions and success metrics.
description_zh: 制定上市策略：渠道、信息、定价、首发动作与成功指标。

name: growth-loops
description_en: Identify growth loops (flywheels): where the output of one step brings in new users.
description_zh: 找增长循环（飞轮）：哪一步的产出会反过来带来新用户。

name: pre-mortem
description_en: Pre-mortem: assume the project already failed, work backwards to causes, and assign prevention actions.
description_zh: 事前验尸：假设项目已失败，倒推原因并给出预防动作。

name: sprint-plan
description_en: Plan a sprint: capacity estimation, story selection, dependencies and risks.
description_zh: 规划一个冲刺：容量估算、故事选择、依赖与风险。

name: monetization-strategy
description_en: Brainstorm 3–5 monetization approaches — subscription, usage, service, licensing, commission — with fit and risk.
description_zh: brainstorm 3–5 种变现方式：订阅、按量、服务、授权、佣金，并评估匹配度与风险。

name: product-vision
description_en: Write a product vision: who it's for, what changes, and what it looks like in three years.
description_zh: 写产品愿景：为谁、带来什么改变、三年后是什么样。

name: product-strategy
description_en: A nine-section product strategy: vision, market, competition, positioning, roadmap, metrics, resources, risks and trade-offs.
description_zh: 九段式产品战略：愿景、市场、竞争、定位、路线、指标、资源、风险与取舍。

name: opportunity-solution-tree
description_en: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree: outcome → opportunities → solutions → experiments.
description_zh: 画机会解决方案树：目标 → 机会 → 方案 → 实验。

name: prioritize-features
description_en: Prioritize features by impact, effort, risk and strategic fit.
description_zh: 按影响、成本、风险与战略匹配度给功能排优先级。

name: analyze-feature-requests
description_en: Cluster a pile of feature requests into themes and rank by strategic fit and impact.
description_zh: 把一堆功能请求聚类成主题，按战略契合度与影响排序。

name: stakeholder-map
description_en: Map stakeholders on a power/interest grid with a communication plan per quadrant.
description_zh: 用权力/利益矩阵画干系人地图，并给每类人沟通策略。

name: metrics-dashboard
description_en: Design a metrics dashboard: key metrics, definitions, sources, refresh cadence and alert thresholds.
description_zh: 设计指标看板：核心指标、口径、数据源、更新频率与告警阈值。

name: marketing-ideas
description_en: Generate five low-cost marketing ideas: channel, message, action and how to measure.
description_zh: 生成 5 个低成本营销点子：渠道、信息、执行动作与衡量方式。

name: startup-canvas
description_en: Startup Canvas: combine the nine-section product strategy with the business model canvas on one page.
description_zh: Startup Canvas：把产品战略九段与商业模式画布合成一页。

name: brand
description_en: Build a brand: voice, visual identity, messaging framework and asset management.
description_zh: 建立品牌：品牌声音、视觉识别、信息框架与素材管理。

name: design-system
description_en: Build a design system: token architecture, component specs and slide generation.
description_zh: 搭建设计系统：token 架构、组件规范与幻灯片生成。

name: ui-ux-pro-max
description_en: UI/UX design intelligence for web, mobile and desktop: layout, color, components and interaction advice.
description_zh: 面向 Web/移动/桌面的 UI/UX 设计智能：布局、配色、组件与交互建议。

name: architecture-diagram
description_en: Generate polished dark-themed architecture diagrams as self-contained HTML, exportable to image or PDF.
description_zh: 生成深色主题的架构图：自包含 HTML，可导出图片或 PDF。

name: porters-five-forces
description_en: Porter's Five Forces: rivalry, suppliers, buyers, substitutes and new entrants.
description_zh: 波特五力分析：竞争、供应商、买方、替代品与新进入者。

name: pestle-analysis
description_en: PESTLE analysis: political, economic, social, technological, environmental and legal.
description_zh: PESTLE 分析：政治、经济、社会、技术、环境与法律。

name: value-proposition
description_en: Design a value proposition with the six-part JTBD template: who, job, current solution, gap, promise.
description_zh: 用六段式 JTBD 模板设计价值主张：为谁、什么任务、现有方案、差距与承诺。

name: positioning-ideas
description_en: Brainstorm 3–5 differentiated positioning ideas, with the trade-offs of each.
description_zh: brainstorm 3–5 个差异化定位，并说明每个定位的取舍。

name: design
description_en: A comprehensive design sub-skill: brand identity, design tokens, UI styling and slides.
description_zh: 综合设计子技能：品牌识别、design token、UI 样式与幻灯片。

name: prioritization-frameworks
description_en: A reference guide to nine prioritization frameworks: formulas, when to use, and pitfalls.
description_zh: 9 种优先级框架的参考指南：公式、适用场景与坑。

name: ui-styling
description_en: Build accessible interfaces with shadcn/ui: layout, states and interaction rules.
description_zh: 用 shadcn/ui 组件做可访问的界面：布局、状态与交互规范。

name: strategy-red-team
description_en: Red-team a PRD, roadmap or strategy: find load-bearing assumptions and attack each one.
description_zh: 红队攻击 PRD/路线图/战略：找出承重假设并逐条攻击。

name: ansoff-matrix
description_en: Ansoff Matrix: four growth strategies across existing/new products and markets.
description_zh: 安索夫矩阵：现有/新产品 × 现有/新市场的四种增长策略。

name: beachhead-segment
description_en: Pick the first beachhead segment by accessibility, size and competition.
description_zh: 选首个滩头市场：按可进入性、规模与竞争评估。

name: brainstorm-experiments-existing
description_en: Design validation experiments for an existing product: prototypes, fake doors, A/B tests, interviews.
description_zh: 为现有产品设计验证实验：原型、假门、A/B 与访谈。

name: brainstorm-experiments-new
description_en: Design lean experiments (pretotypes) for a new product: fake doors, landing pages, concierge tests.
description_zh: 为新产品设计精益实验（pretotype）：假门、落地页、concierge 测试。

name: brainstorm-ideas-existing
description_en: Brainstorm feature ideas for an existing product from user, business and technical perspectives.
description_zh: 为现有产品做多视角功能 brainstorm：用户、商业、技术三视角。

name: brainstorm-ideas-new
description_en: Early-stage brainstorming for a new product: ten directions starting from user problems.
description_zh: 新产品初期 brainstorm：从用户问题出发给 10 个方向。

name: gtm-motions
description_en: Identify the seven GTM motions (inbound, outbound, PLG, channel, etc.) and pick the best fit.
description_zh: 识别 7 种 GTM 动作（inbound、outbound、PLG、渠道等）并选最适合的。

name: identify-assumptions-existing
description_en: Identify risky assumptions for an existing feature: value, usability, feasibility, business.
description_zh: 识别现有产品功能的风险假设：价值、可用性、可行性、商业。

name: identify-assumptions-new
description_en: List assumptions for a new product across eight risk categories: demand, market, channel, pricing and more.
description_zh: 新产品想法按 8 类风险列假设：需求、市场、渠道、定价等。

name: intended-vs-implemented
description_en: Find the gap between what a system is supposed to do and what it actually does, then locate the cause.
description_zh: 找出「系统应该做」与「实际做」之间的差距，并定位原因。

name: prioritize-assumptions
description_en: Prioritize assumptions with an impact × risk matrix and suggest which to test first.
description_zh: 用影响×风险矩阵给假设排序，并建议先验证哪些。

name: product-name
description_en: Generate five product names: memorable, registrable, aligned with positioning, with rationale.
description_zh: 为产品起 5 个名字：好记、可注册、与定位一致，并给理由。

name: wwas
description_en: Write backlog items in Why-What-Acceptance format: why, what, acceptance.
description_zh: 用 Why-What-Acceptance 格式写 backlog 项：为什么、做什么、怎么验收。
